errors.UNMANAGED_INSTALL: An external installation occupies the target directory. Back up and handle it manually; VLauncher will not overwrite it.
errors.LOCAL_CHANGES: Installed source files were modified or removed. Preserve and resolve your changes before updating.
errors.COMFY_RUNNING: Stop ComfyUI, then check again before installing.
errors.BUSY: Another installation is running. Wait for it to finish.
errors.PYTHON_MISSING: ComfyUI Python was not found. Check the environment settings.
errors.ENVIRONMENT_INVALID: The environment did not pass the V3 API compatibility check. See the details and console log.
errors.PATH_INVALID: Path validation failed. Check paths, permissions and directory links.
errors.MIRROR_INVALID: Use an HTTPS GitHub mirror URL without credentials or query parameters.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: GitHub rate limit reached. Try again later.
errors.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: Download failed. Check your network or mirror settings and retry.
errors.DOWNLOAD_TIMEOUT: Download timed out. Check your network or mirror settings and retry.
errors.ARCHIVE_INVALID: The download is not a valid node source archive or contains unsupported paths.
errors.DATA_CONFLICT: New package files conflict with user data. Back up and resolve the listed files first.
errors.DEPENDENCY_FAILED: Python dependency installation failed. Node files were not switched. See the logs and retry; shared Python dependencies are not rolled back.
errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Node import or registration failed. Node files were not switched. See the compatibility error in the logs.
errors.INSTALL_FAILED: Installation did not complete. See the details and console log.
errors.RECOVERY_REQUIRED: A previous directory switch was interrupted or could not be restored. Review the transaction record and backups before continuing.
errors.PROCESS_CHECK_FAILED: Unable to check whether ComfyUI is running. Check process access permissions and retry.
